Hi Sofia — thanks for the brief and the context. Really excited by the potential here. Quick answers and next steps from our side: 

1) White-labeling: We support a white-label/embedded SDK and can ship an SDK that surfaces only the APIs you need. There are two layers to discuss: branding removal (straightforward) and telemetry integration (we surface token/latency metrics and can forward them via a secure webhook or push to your AWS Kinesis).

2) Hosting options: Private (VPC) deployments are possible for larger customers; Dedicated pools can be reserved for consistent latency for your tenant. VPC/private will carry a platform fee + infra pass-through. We’ll need to align on data residency for EU customers if you have that requirement.

3) Commercials: I’ve attached an initial term sheet (redwood_oem_term_sheet_v1.docx) with three starter bands (reserved capacity tiers + overage). This is flexible; we usually do a commitment + discounted token rate + a commercial uplift for white-labeling and co-marketing.

4) Accreditation / Go-to-market badge: We can create a partner accreditation badge and a short enablement one-pager for your reps. This is typically gated on a short technical integration review and a security questionnaire completion.

Proposed next step: 30-minute call to align technical owners and commercial expectations. Can you do Thu 16 Sep 10:30–11:00 PDT? If so I’ll invite Karthik (product partnerships for private/Dedicated) and Ben (revenue/partnerships).

Thanks,
